purpose: Caller-checked hand-off for one shared definition/contract pair; this asset is a report guide, not an executed check.

required.job: Original fixed job path/id and caller-held digest; compare with the helper digest.
required.writerEvidence: Complete helper stdout/stderr and actual exit; paths resolve against the original draft root.
required.files: Actual complete final paths, lengths, SHA-256 hashes, before/after diff and unchanged baseline inventory.
required.scope: Protected notes, fixed values, source/loading/runtime pins and exact create/reuse/update limits checked against original inputs.
required.callerValidation: Pinned contract-check commands, checkout revision, complete raw log pins and actual exits from independent execution; state unverified until performed.
required.bindingFindings: Required versus optional permitted affordances; source checked/unavailable and execution unverified remain distinct.
required.provenance: Disposition, actual author/licence, inspected source/pin/comparison/retained notices, unresolved items and review pending unless separately completed.
required.qualityFindings: Author findings and any separately executed evaluator judgment, each tied to final hashes; never substitute deterministic validity for quality.
required.liveEvidence: Unverified unless separately authorized maintainer-led Host records establish the specific behavior.
required.openItems: Named owner, missing evidence/decision, consequence and next action; preserve a blocked or partial draft honestly.
required.upstreamPreparation: Only when requested: full pinned artifact-contribution template, base dev, sent false; no automatic publication.

limits: Helper preparation has acceptedDraft false and validation/quality/live limitations.
A source pin or tool grant proves no runtime loading, invocation or legal clearance.
Only the caller compares retained job/digest and independently checks actual final bytes/results.
No Host/model/provider run, install, repository commit/push, PR or merge is authorized by this report.
